arms.order: per world fixed RNG permutation of all 8 arms
arms.sidecars: not parsed in timed inference; include original/package/source SHA and full removed provenance

data.models: exact 20 final models in published MODEL_FREEZE.json; derive only after model publication
data.worlds: exact original confirmation cohort manifests and SHA files; no new worlds

endpoints.cpu: log ratio of fit mean complete CPU renewal/ordinary; upper < log(.90)
endpoints.latency: log ratio of within-fit complete wall p95 renewal/ordinary; upper < log(1.05)
endpoints.quality: renewal minus ordinary mean utility; lower > -0.02
endpoints.throughput: log ratio of serial service throughput renewal/ordinary; lower > log(.95)

inference.independent_unit: five independent fits; first aggregate 40 paired worlds per fit and split
inference.interval: paired Student t df4: mean +/- t.ppf(1-.05/(2*48),4)*sampleSD/sqrt(5)
inference.original_gates: primary14 and secondary24 untouched; this auxiliary family cannot rescue original failure
inference.robustness: all four endpoint gates must pass for both formats within a split/comparator; report all 48 intervals regardless of pass

integrity.failure: no overwrite; retain failed runs; reject mutation or invalid package; no tuning from confirmation outcomes
preconditions: all20 final weights published and immutable
original400 cohort manifest file hashes verified
raw and slim weights and predictions exact before timing
original frozen20 source hashes verified before and after
integrity.runner: separate auxiliary runner may call frozen execute without editing candidate source; protocol and helper published before confirmation generation

package.native: NumPy only; no native parser or production qualification claimed
package.numbers: retain all inference JSON numbers exactly; no quantization
package.required_fields: NumpyPolicy actual consumption, symmetric projection for every family
package.validation: every retained leaf type and float64 bytes exact after JSON roundtrip; q/belief/mass/bank/logit exact on 14 public-only fixture states per model

scope: Representation robustness only; original primary14 and secondary24 unchanged and not replaced

timing.comparisons: same-format renewal/value versus each of full_markov,affine_markov,gru/value on paired identical worlds; raw and slim separately
timing.decoder_setup: fresh fit decoder setup charged once; full setup recorded and divided by 640 actual requests per fit (2 formats*4 families*2 splits*40)
timing.endpoint_cpu: mean full_execution_cpu_seconds plus per-request actual decoder setup CPU share
timing.endpoint_latency: within-fit np.percentile(40 complete request wall times,95) including decoder setup share
timing.endpoint_throughput: 40 / sum(40 complete request wall times); serial service only
timing.exclusions: teacher/evaluator diagnostics after execution timers; archive writes, package derivation, imports and supervisor costs recorded separately in whole-process ledger; no network service claim
timing.measured: frozen joint_campaign.execute: model JSON load and NumpyPolicy construction, public JSON load, Owner initialization and every actual action, all forecasts/heads, actual due READ content open/decode, pre-audit wire JSON serialization
timing.nonadditive: model_load and control+Owner sub-timers are nested within full_execution; never sum them twice
